title: Format Leak
summary: A feedback terminal echoes your message with printf, using it as the format string. The secret is one pointer away.
objectives: Confirm the input is used as a printf format string
Read stack memory with positional specifiers
Recover the secret the service loaded
learningOutcomes: Explain how an attacker-controlled format string discloses memory
Use %p and %N$s to walk the stack
Fix it with a constant format string and least privilege

references.label: CWE-134: Use of Externally-Controlled Format String

hints.bodyMd: Send `%p %p %p %p`. Those aren't printed literally, so the program is using your text as a format string. Each `%p` prints a stack word.

One of the stack words is a pointer to the secret. Use `%N$s` to dereference the N-th argument as a string; try each N from 1 upward until the flag appears. A wrong N may close the connection, so reconnect and continue.
